stages.title: Logic vocabulary
stages.body: Separate implication, converse, contrapositive and equivalence.

stages.title: Patterns and series
stages.body: Test the simplest stable rule and verify every term.

stages.title: Coding-decoding
stages.body: Infer a rule from all examples, not one coincidence.

stages.title: Relations
stages.body: Build a labelled family graph without assuming gender or generation.

stages.title: Syllogisms
stages.body: Use set containment and test existential claims carefully.

stages.title: Arrangements
stages.body: Place fixed constraints before flexible ones.

stages.title: Counting
stages.body: Apply product, sum, permutation and combination rules with exclusions.

stages.title: Probability
stages.body: Define equally likely outcomes and conditional sample spaces.

stages.title: Data interpretation
stages.body: Read labels, units, bases and totals before calculating.

stages.title: Decision scenarios
stages.body: Separate facts, constraints, objectives and feasible options.

stages.title: Verification
stages.body: Enumerate small cases, reverse codes and sanity-check totals.
